title: Let Everything Praise Him!
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who notices things — and tonight's psalms are a roll-call of everything already praising Heavenly Father, which only becomes a song once somebody stops and hears it.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout loves to notice everything praising Heavenly Father. In Scout’s world today: on a walk, Scout listened to the birds chirping, the wind whooshing the trees, and a puppy’s happy bark. “It’s like the whole world is singing to Heavenly Father!” Scout said, and started humming a thank-You song too. Just like the psalm that calls everything to praise Him, Scout discovered that all creation — and Scout — can join the joyful song.
